newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Uraco in S$2.54 mln lighting venture.
newsitem.headline: Uraco in S$2.54 mln lighting venture.

text.p: Precision engineering firm Uraco Holdings Ltd (UHL) said on Wednesday it had acquired energy-saving lighting products and technologies from Newtronics (M) Sdn Bhd for about Singapore $2.54 million.
The company said in statement the purchase, part of its diversification plans, was made by its wholly-owned subsidiary Uraco Electronics Sdn Bhd (UEM).
"Now, we are moving into lighting which basically propels us into the electrical products arena," Lim Ee Ann, managing director of UHL said.
Under the agreement, Uraco Electronics Pte Ltd (UE) will produce energy-saving lamps.
UHL will hold a 70 percent stake in UE while Newtronics will hold 25 percent. The remaining five percent will be held equally by two employees of UE.
The purchase would be financed by bank borrowings, the statement said.
